messages:
maria: alert: prod-usw2 GPU nodes stuck PendingJoin after yesterday's IAM session TTL change. noticed by healthcheck.

dan: saw it too. allocator logs show STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failures + KMS Decrypt AccessDenied. snippet: 
ERROR keystore.Decrypt AccessDenied: KMS grant expired (403)

luke: confirm security rolled session-duration to 1h at 2026-03-18T13:00. allocator assumes it can refresh tokens earlier.

maria: consequence = node bootstrap fails (can't decrypt disk secrets), warm pools not filling.

security-bot: policy-change applied: iam/session-duration=1h by luke at 2026-03-18T13:02. AuditID: AUD-8742.

dan: mitigation options: revert TTL, allowlist allocator assume-role, or restart allocator after patch. least blast radius = scoped allowlist.

luke: I'll open CR and patch authz-exceptions configmap for allocator-prod-usw2. then restart allocator-controller.

maria: going to monitor join_rate and keystore_decrypt_errors. will add dashboard alerts.

luke: patched authz-exceptions and annotated audit. scaling allocator-controller 0->3 now.

dan: join events coming through; decrypt errors dropping (180 -> 4).

maria: keeping allowlist for 24h, filing allocator ticket to fix refresh flow for short TTLs. adding preflight check to session-rollout checklist.

luke: filing CR-5012 and ticket ALLOC-720.

maria: incident resolved (partial) at 2026-03-18T14:06:40. will keep monitoring 60m.
